caption: The drawing features a round plate with a decorative floral design. The primary colors used are various shades of brown, green, and a muted yellowish-tan background. The plate is bordered with a thin brown line, and the inner edge has a dotted brown pattern. The main composition inside the plate consists of symmetrical, stylized floral motifs with elongated brown petals or leaves, green foliage, and delicate curved stems. One central flower with green leaves emanates from the bottom center, extending towards the middle of the plate. Additional brown floral shapes, each with touches of green, extend on both sides and the upper edge. The plate imagery includes swirling, fine lines that outline and embellish the leaves and petals. Near the lower right portion, the inscription "March 2, 1810" is written in brown ink, with some additional cursive script on the left side. The plate is centered on a plain, unadorned background.
title: Pa. German Plate
